metadata.description: This course covers 5 of 6 courses of Big Data Specialization (UC San Diego) on the Coursera platform. This course will prepare students to ask the right questions about data, communicate effectively with data scientists, and do basic exploration of large, complex datasets. By following along with provided code, students will experience how one can perform predictive modeling and leverage graph analytics to model problems. They will be guided through the basics of using Hadoop with MapReduce, Spark, Pig and Hive.

clos.clo_details: Explain basis concepts in big data, architectural components and programming models used for scalable big data analysis.
Collect, store and organize data using big data solutions
Design a big data information system for small company
Execute simple big data integration and processing on Hadoop and Spark platforms
Use tools and algorithms to create machine learning models that learn from data, and to scale those models up to big data problems
Model a problem into a graph database and perform analytical tasks over the graph in a scalable manner.
